title: Lithe declarative plugin manifest (plugin contract v1)
description: Shape of plugin.json for a declarative plugin. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express (cross references, permissions, activation events, template variables) are defined in README.md and enforced by plugins.declarative.validate.

requires.description: API level 3: every capability the manifest uses, each with the version of that capability's contract it was written against. Required at level 3 and refused below it. Listing a capability the manifest does not use, or leaving out one it uses, is refused.

backend.description: Required exactly when backend is present: the plugin's own process serving its web pages.

buildProviders.description: Required exactly when any buildSystems[].provider is present, including own-process and shared language-server providers. Declares host support for Provider orchestration, independent of declarative buildSystems and serverProcess launch support.

buildSystems.description: Declarative build detection, models, and command plans; does not imply buildProviders support.

debugAdapters.description: Required exactly when debugAdapters is non-empty. The DAP session itself is negotiated by the adapter in initialize.

executableResolution.description: Shared executable candidate ordering and strict selection.

projectGenerators.description: Entries of the New Project window: fields, requirements, and steps.

serverProcess.description: The launch fields of language servers, of build providers that start their own process, of VCS providers, of debug adapters, and of the plugin backend. Version 2 adds runSelectedRuntime and is required exactly when a debug adapter uses it (pluginAPIVersion 4).

ui.description: Version 2 adds web content; version 3 adds native controls.

vcsProviders.description: Required exactly when vcsProviders is non-empty. The provider protocol itself is negotiated in initialize (shared/contracts/vcs-provider-v1.md).

buildSystems.description: pluginAPIVersion 3: build systems Core detects, models, and plans commands for. Requires process.build and one onBuildSystem:<id> activation event per build system.

backend.description: pluginAPIVersion 3, requires.backend 1: the plugin's own LSP base-protocol process. The host starts it on the first plugin-function call from one of the plugin's web pages, keeps one process per plugin independent of any workspace, and ends it when the plugin is disabled, updated, or uninstalled. Requires backend.launch and a web tool window; credentials.store lets it use the host's private credential store.

vcsProviders.description: pluginAPIVersion 3: version control systems the plugin provides, each through its own LSP base-protocol process. Requires languageServer.launch, process.vcs, and one onVcsRoot:<id> activation event per provider.

debugAdapters.description: pluginAPIVersion 4, requires.debugAdapters 1: debug adapters the plugin implements, each started as its own DAP process. Requires debug.launch (and debug.attach when an adapter serves attach) and one onDebug:<id> activation event per adapter.

projectGenerators.description: pluginAPIVersion 3 with requires.projectGenerators: entries of the New Project window. Requires the project.generate permission.

web.description: ui 2: the plugin's own page, served from the package into a sandboxed host web view. Needs the ui.web permission.

entry.description: Package-relative path of the HTML entry page.

debugPackagePath.description: Read-only package-relative path. Core must additionally reject escaping symlinks and platform-specific path escapes.

debugServerProcessV1.description: Reuse existing launch fields and validation. LSP initializationOptions have no meaning for a DAP transport and are excluded.

debugRunSelectedRuntimeProcess.description: Proposed serverProcess 2 branch. Resolve through Run's selected runtime for this target, not a plugin dependency or a separate Debug runtime preference.

endpoint.description: A bounded line decoder, not an executable-name-specific format or a regex engine. Only loopback endpoints are accepted.
A fixed loopback port for this adapter process, not the debuggee's attach port. Conflicts fail explicitly; no automatic port substitution.

debugSelector.description: Optional automatic matching: OR between selectors, AND between fields. Omission means explicit selection only, not a wildcard registration.

arguments.description: Adapter-owned default DAP arguments. Ordinary JSON data; no embedded references, expressions or resource handles are interpreted.

parametersSchema.description: Optional packaged schema for final merged DAP arguments, with local read-only refs only. Not a new Debug configuration file.

targetBindings.description: Typed projections into known DAP fields. They only fill missing arguments; explicit values retain their existing precedence.

program.description: `target.path` is the target's own path. `target.executable` is the program the host found through `executable`, which then must be declared.

executable.description: Launch only. Where a host finds the program a source file builds into: the user's `file` setting first, then the candidates. Required exactly when `targetBindings.program` is `target.executable`.

setting.description: ID of a `file` setting of the same plugin.

candidates.description: Paths tried in order when the setting is empty. Each starts with `${workspaceFolder}/` or `${fileDirectory}/` and may use `${fileBasenameNoExtension}`; no `..`.

debugCapabilities.description: Optional suppression only. Disabled entries are standard DAP initialize capability names plus exceptionBreakpointFilters. Omission follows DAP; true values and function implementations are not accepted.

debugConsole.description: Debugger commands the adapter's console understands, offered as completions while typing in the Debug Console. Adapters that answer the DAP completions request complete live; this list is for the ones that do not. Names are inserted as written; Core refuses padded or duplicate names.

commandPrefix.description: Text the adapter's console reads as "what follows is a debugger command". The host puts it before the typed line when it asks the adapter to complete, so the adapter proposes commands instead of expression keywords. No spaces.

description.description: One line shown beside the name, as written. Not translated by the host.

adapterID.description: DAP initialize adapterID. Defaults to the local adapter id; never substitutes for the qualified Registry identity.

requests.description: Defaults to launch only. Attach must be explicitly declared and separately authorized.

configurationTypes.description: Optional imported launch.json type aliases. Ambiguity requires selection; aliases do not override another provider.

field.description: A field declared earlier in the same generator.

default.description: text: a template over ${project.name} and earlier fields; enum: an option; boolean; multiSelect: options. Not allowed for runtime.

maximumVersion.description: text and enum: the highest version the value may name, a template over earlier fields such as ${field.jdk.major}.

url.description: https address without query or fragment; http only for loopback hosts.

hostIntegration.description: pluginAPIVersion 2, official plugins only: a named host integration and the package resources it reads.

capabilities.description: Process-backed features of the language that the host's own implementation provides through the integration.

serverProcess.description: The launch fields a language server, a pluginAPIVersion 3 build provider, and a VCS provider share; all are LSP base-protocol processes and pass the same validation.

oneOf.description: pluginAPIVersion 2: a packaged entry file started by a host-discovered runtime.

initializationOptions.description: pluginAPIVersion 2: LSP initializationOptions; string values are launch templates.

buildProvider.description: pluginAPIVersion 3: the LSP base-protocol process that answers lithe/build/model and lithe/build/dependencies. It either names a language server of the same plugin or declares its own server process.

languageServer.description: The languageID of a language server the same plugin declares; the host reuses that session.

backend.description: Launch fields of the plugin backend. ${workspaceStateDir} is refused because the backend is not bound to a workspace.

vcsProvider.description: pluginAPIVersion 3: a VCS provider process (shared/contracts/vcs-provider-v1.md). Detection uses the markers only and never starts the process; capabilities are negotiated, not declared.

id.description: Stable VCS ID; git is reserved for the built-in support.

markers.description: Entries directly inside a root that mark it.

metadataPaths.description: Root-relative paths the host watches; a change means the status may be stale.

tool.description: The VCS client the provider drives. The host resolves it like a systemCommand launch and passes its absolute path with every request.

minimumVersion.description: pluginAPIVersion 2: one to three dot-separated numbers, for example 21 or 18.17.

buildArgument.description: A template string, or one emitted only when every condition holds. See README.md for variables and guards.

buildFieldSpec.description: A selector ("", @key, /a/b, or $/a/b), a selector with a transform, or a literal value.

icon.description: Icon of the build system's tool window and activity bar entry; display only.

executableSetting.description: buildSystems 2: global file setting with effect reload or nextRun; empty uses discovery, nonempty must be used without fallback.

items.description: java, node, and go are host-managed and take only id and minimumVersion; any other runtime declares its executables and version probe.

hostIntegration.description: Official plugins only; the host must provide the named integration.

presentation.description: Display only. toolbar: a toggle button in the tool window toolbar (boolean options with an icon). tree: a checklist node at the top of the tool window tree (multiSelect options).

icon.description: Icon of a toolbar option; only toolbar options have one.

oneOf.description: pluginAPIVersion 3: the build provider answers lithe/build/model with a litheBuildModel document.

category.description: Headings the host files the task under, outermost first; the default for model tasks of a fromModel template. Display only.

oneOf.description: pluginAPIVersion 3: the build provider answers lithe/build/dependencies with a litheDependencies document.
